decisions.reason: After two years of learning, the fifteen-day express program looks the least distinctive within an overlapping set of delivery offers, so its routines can be folded into stronger formats with limited loss of useful knowledge.
The seventy-two-hour express program remains a clearly differentiated premium offer that draws directly on the firm's existing manufacturing, scheduling, and service capabilities.
The broader express line for doors and gates fits the core product-service system well and gives the firm a larger base from which to absorb customer feedback and refine multiple models.

The online ordering and digital services platform deepens the firm's advisory and service model, and its existing technical and organizational knowledge gives good scope for continued improvement rather than withdrawal.

The fire and smoke protection door is highly complementary to the firm's established safety, compliance, and engineering expertise, making it a strong candidate for retention and incremental development.
